dash.lead: Your most-used switches and status at a glance.
dash.llmNotReady: The LLM isn't fully configured yet, so translation falls back to the regular engines.

dash.targetLangHint: Both overlay and immersive mode translate into this language.

engine.bing.name: Bing Web Translator (free)
engine.bing.note: Bing web API. Works in mainland China without a proxy
engine.deepl.name: DeepL (official API)
engine.deepl.note: Free tier: 500,000 characters/month; keys ending in :fx use the free endpoint automatically
engine.deeplx.name: DeepLX (self-hosted)
engine.deeplx.note: URL of your self-hosted DeepLX service; api_key is an optional access token
engine.edge.name: Microsoft Translator (free)
engine.edge.note: Edge's built-in translation API; falls back to Bing web on failure. Works in mainland China without a proxy
engine.google.name: Google Cloud Translation (official API)
engine.google.note: Requires the Cloud Translation API to be enabled; needs a proxy in mainland China
engine.google_free.name: Google Translate (free)
engine.google_free.note: Needs a proxy in mainland China; frequent calls get rate-limited. base_url can point to a mirror
engine.microsoft.name: Microsoft Translator (official API)
engine.microsoft.note: Azure Translator resource; free tier: 2 million characters/month
engine.openai.name: LLM (OpenAI-compatible)
engine.openai.note: Any OpenAI-compatible service; more fluent translations but slower
engines.fallback.desc: Each is tried in turn until one succeeds.
engines.fallback.none: No fallback set. Errors from the primary engine are reported directly.
engines.fallback.title: If the primary engine fails, try in order
engines.fallback.titleLlm: If the LLM fails, try in order
engines.field.api_key.label: API key

engines.field.base_url.label: Endpoint URL
engines.field.model.label: Model
engines.field.proxy.label: Proxy

engines.field.region.label: Region
engines.lead: Choose the translation method, primary engine and fallback order. Changes apply immediately; text already in the translation library is not affected.
engines.llm.desc: Any OpenAI-compatible service (official, cloud providers or self-hosted).
engines.llm.title: LLM
engines.method.engineDesc: Translated by a machine translation engine: fast, and free engines need no setup.
engines.method.llmDesc: Translated by an LLM: more fluent but slower. Falls back to the engines below if the LLM fails.
engines.method.title: Translation method
engines.test.hint: Translate a short English sentence to check connectivity and latency
engines.test.label: Test
engines.title: Translation engines

general.configFileDesc: Always kept in your user folder; {app} reads it on startup.
general.enginesHint: Set up translation engines and LLMs on the {page} page.
general.lead: Settings shared by overlay and immersive mode.
general.resetConfirmBody: The file will be moved to the data folder. Its contents stay the same.
general.resetConfirmTitle: Move translation memory back to the default location?
general.targetLangDesc: All text is translated into this language.
general.uiLangDesc: Language used by the settings window, tray menu and translation frames.
general.useStoreDesc: Save translations locally so repeated text doesn't hit the engine again.
glossary.builtin.desc: Fixed translations for {n} common UI terms ({lang}). Add the same original as a custom term to override.
glossary.builtin.title: Built-in glossary
glossary.custom.desc: {n} terms · Useful for fixing mistranslated single words, e.g. New → 新建
glossary.custom.title: Custom terms
glossary.lead: Matches the whole original text exactly (ignoring leading and trailing spaces); matches skip both the library and the engine. Priority: custom terms > built-in terms > translation library > engine.
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.toast.emptyTarget: The translation for “{term}” can't be empty
glossary.toast.saved: Glossary saved. Attached pages will refresh right away
immersive.detect.found: Found {n} apps. Choose one to take over:
immersive.detect.none: No running Electron apps found. Open the app you want to translate first, or add it manually.
immersive.footnote: Currently supports Electron / Chromium-based apps. Takeover is refused if the program behind the port doesn't match the configuration.
immersive.form.argsPh: Leave empty: read automatically when you click “Launch in immersive mode” while the app is running
immersive.form.exe: Program path (for identity check and launch)
immersive.form.name: Name
immersive.form.prefixes: Only pages whose URL starts with (empty = all)
immersive.form.skipsPh: One CSS selector per line, e.g. .chat-message
immersive.hotkey.desc: Switch the display at any time in attached apps. Takes effect after restarting {app}.
immersive.hotkey.label: Original / translation toggle shortcut
immersive.lead: Replaces interface text with translations right inside the app, without modifying the app itself. Only apps listed here and launched in immersive mode are taken over.
immersive.noExe: No program path set, so identity can't be verified
immersive.remove.body: This app will no longer be taken over, and translated pages will revert to the original text. The app itself is not affected.
immersive.remove.title: Remove “{name}”?
immersive.title: Immersive mode
immersive.toast.off: Immersive mode off. Pages restored to original text
immersive.toast.targetOff: Disabled “{name}”. Pages restored to original text
library.clear.body: Translations for target language {lang} will be deleted, and this text will be sent to the engine again next time. Translations already on screen update after the page refreshes.
library.clear.title: Clear the translation library?
library.deleteHint: Delete (attached pages will translate this text again)
library.editHint: Press Enter or click away to save
library.lead: Everything translated is stored here and reused the next time the same text appears, without calling an engine. Edited translations are marked as manual and never overwritten by automatic translation; edits are pushed to attached pages immediately.
library.title: Translation library
library.toast.deleted: Deleted. Pages will translate this text again
library.toast.edited: Translation updated. Attached pages will refresh right away
overlayPage.heroDescAfter: anytime to select an area of the screen; the translation is laid over it.
overlayPage.lead: For images, videos and any app immersive mode can't reach. Frames can be moved and resized, and re-translate automatically when their position or content changes.
overlayPage.modeOcrDesc: Reads text with the built-in offline OCR, then sends it to the translation engine. Vision translation is coming soon.
overlayPage.modeVisionDesc: An LLM reads and translates the image directly.
overlayPage.ocrAutoHint: Prefers an installed language that differs from the target language
overlayPage.ocrLangDesc: Language of the text on screen. The matching language pack must be installed in system settings.
overlayPage.ocrLangNone: No OCR languages found. Add a language pack under Language in system settings.
select.hint: Drag to select the area to translate. Press Esc to cancel.
settings.title: Settings · Translate Anything

status.list_failed: Debug port {port} is open, but reading the page list failed: {e}
status.no_port: Running, but not launched in immersive mode (no debug port)
status.port_already_open: The debug port is already open; no restart needed
status.port_taken: Debug port {port} is taken by another program ({path}); takeover refused
status.port_unknown: Debug port {port} is taken by an unrecognized process ({pid}); takeover refused
status.reopening: The app has quit; reopening in immersive mode…
status.wait_exit: Please fully quit "{name}" from its tray menu (closing the window isn't enough). It will reopen in immersive mode automatically.
